svg.title: Lone Trader - interpreted silhouette
svg.desc: Traders and Gunboats (2024), printed 80-81, PDF 81-82. Single-deck envelope retains flat chamfered cockpit nose, long central cargo body, midbody side fairings and open central stern recess between rear shoulders. Illustration supports boxy narrow trader with side pods. Fine cylindrical shaping simplified to plan projection; internal cargo and crane borders excluded.
